apps/web/components/features/agent-room/.permission-denied: The room is presentational and takes a projected view; it has no access gate. The detector matched agent.role, which is an agent job title.

apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthPa.offline: A pure loading placeholder with no data or network calls: it draws the same skeleton whether the browser is online or offline. The detector matched the skeleton it is.

apps/web/components/features/auth/atoms/.long-content: The visible label is the fixed word Back; no caller text is rendered (ariaLabel only names the control), so there is no long content to wrap.

apps/web/components/features/connectors/.loading: The card renders a projected suggestion and never fetches. The detector matched the pending approval status, which is shown as Approve and Reject (PartialLocation, ReadOnlyNoHandlers stories).
apps/web/components/features/connectors/.offline: The card never fetches or submits on its own; Approve and Reject are caller callbacks, so a network state belongs to the caller. The detector inferred it from the pending status.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoAu.empty: Takes no props and always reads the fixed twelve-member demo audience; the empty audience belongs to DashboardAudienceWorkspace.
apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoAu.error: Its only failure paths are toasts for a failed copy or QR download (covered in DemoAudienceWorkspace.test.tsx); the workspace itself has no error view.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoAv.empty: The avatar draws one assignee and has no collection to empty. The detector matched the items-center class.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoPl.empty: Renders null: it only seeds the shared player store with one fixed canonical release. The detector matched releases in the fixture import.
apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoPl.long-content: Renders null and takes no props; the seeded track is the fixed canonical release, so there is no caller text.
apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoPl.rtl-overflow: Renders null and takes no props, so it draws nothing a document direction could affect.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoPr.error: A static glyph with no failure path. The detector matched the --color-error token used for the urgent bars.
apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoPr.long-content: Labels come from a fixed five-entry map and render only inside the SVG title; no caller text is drawn.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoRe.empty: The releases come from fixed demo fixtures for each variant, so no input empties the list; the empty release list belongs to ShellReleasesView and ReleasesEmptyState.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoSt.long-content: Labels come from a fixed five-entry map and render only inside the SVG title; no caller text is drawn.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoVi.empty: The page takes no data and draws fixed copy; with the demo video flag off it renders null (covered in DemoVideoPage.test.tsx). The detector matched the items-center class.
apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoVi.long-content: Takes no props: the headline and both calls to action are fixed copy.

apps/web/components/features/dev/FlagBad.error: The provider renders no UI of its own; a blocked storage read falls back to badges off (covered in FlagBadgeContext.test.tsx), so there is no error view.
